evidence.title: ogimagecn - Beautiful OG images, made simple

name: ogimagecn
summary: Open Graph image components and blocks for React, rendered to PNG with Satori through next/og.
description: Copy-paste OG image blocks for blog posts, changelogs, products, events, quotes, photos and shadcn registry cards, plus Satori-safe pieces like avatar, badge, brand mark, grid lines and waveform. Distributed through the shadcn registry with live previews and a playground.
contains: OG blocks: blog, editorial, grid, photo, profile, quote, stat, terminal, product, event, logo, showcase
Satori-safe components: avatar, badge, brand mark, divider, grid lines, waveform
renders real PNGs through the next/og runtime
playground plus an OG scan tool, MCP docs and an agent skill
